summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of UDM Fork (Sky Quality Meter) application. Backend API testing: 100% pass rate (31/31 tests). Frontend UI testing: 100% pass rate (18/18 core tests). All critical features verified: device discovery (FTDI + CH340), connection/disconnection, real-time readings via WebSocket, logging workflow, calibration commands, firmware upload, console commands, and Night Vision mode. Mock mode (SQM_MOCK=1) working correctly to simulate both Unihedron SQM (FTDI, model 3) and DIY SQM ESP8266 (CH340, model 99) devices.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working correctly. esptool intentionally not installed (expected behavior per requirements).

frontend_issues.notes: Minor Recharts console warning about chart dimensions (-1) during initial render - this is a common Recharts timing issue and does not affect functionality. All UI elements render correctly after initial load.

mock_mode_verification.details: SQM_MOCK=1 correctly returns two synthetic devices: /dev/ttyUSB-MOCK-FTDI (VID 0x0403, PID 0x6015, model 3) and /dev/ttyUSB-MOCK-CH340 (VID 0x1A86, PID 0x7523, model 99). Both devices are classified as recommended=true with correct kind labels (sqm-ftdi vs sqm-diy-ch340).

device_discovery.details: GET /api/ports returns both mock devices with correct VID:PID, vendor labels, driver info (ftdi_sio, ch341), and recommended flags. GET /api/ports?only_sqm=true correctly filters to show only SQM-compatible devices.

connection_flow.details: Successfully connected to both CH340 (model 99) and FTDI (model 3) mock devices. Device info correctly parsed (protocol=4, feature=23, serial numbers). Status badge updates correctly in UI.

readings_telemetry.details: GET /api/device/reading returns realistic values: mpsas ~19-20 (dark sky), frequency_hz ~11000-15000, temperature_c ~16-22°C, counts. WebSocket at /api/ws/telemetry streams readings at ~1Hz. Frontend chart accumulates samples correctly.

logging_service.details: POST /api/logging/start creates CSV file, records samples (4 samples in 3 seconds verified), POST /api/logging/stop stops session, GET /api/logging/sessions lists files, GET /api/logging/download/{name} downloads CSV. Frontend UI shows live sample counter and session status.

calibration.details: GET /api/device/calibration parses cx response (light_calibration_mpsas=19.6, dark_calibration_mpsas=8.71). POST /api/device/calibrate with action='arm_light' returns 'z,OK', action='disarm' works, invalid action returns 400.

firmware_management.details: POST /api/firmware/upload accepts multipart file (1019 bytes uploaded), GET /api/firmware/list shows uploaded files. POST /api/firmware/flash correctly returns 400 with message 'esptool not installed' (expected behavior per requirements). Frontend has upload button and file list.

console_commands.details: POST /api/device/command with command='ix' returns raw response 'i,00000004,00000099,00000023,00009999'. Frontend console page has preset buttons (ix, rx, ux, cx, Ix) and command input with send button. Send button correctly disabled when no command entered.

configuration.details: POST /api/device/interval with seconds=60 sends 'Lxxx00000060x' and returns 'L,OK'. Frontend configuration page has interval input and apply button, plus calibration controls (arm/disarm buttons).

night_vision_mode.details: Frontend Night Vision toggle adds 'night-vision' class to HTML element, applying red-tinted theme. Toggle state persists in localStorage.

error_handling.details: Backend correctly returns 409 status when endpoints requiring connection are called before connecting (info, reading, calibration, command, interval, calibrate, logging-start). Frontend shows appropriate error toasts.
